question: How many antibodies and how many human genes did release 25.0 of the Human Protein Atlas cover?

result.question: How many antibodies and how many human genes did release 25.0 of the Human Protein Atlas cover?
result.text: Release 25.0 of the Human Protein Atlas covered over 27,800 antibodies, which target proteins from over 17,400 human genes (representing approximately 88% of human protein-coding genes) [1].
